paragraphs: Mentioned at the end of Midrash Tehillim, chapter 34, saying that each and every righteous person has a world of their own.[^1]

notes.text: מד׳ תהלים ספ״לד is read as Midrash Tehillim, end of chapter 34, without independent named-edition verification. כל צדיק וצדיק is each and every righteous person, not two subjects. בפ״ע is read as בפני עצמו, of their own. The saying’s subject is understood from the heading; its personal title remains R'.
